_note: Three 5 s portrait clips for the Xtudio 'Content That Inspires Action' triptych. Written in MiniMax H3's single-block format (look, scene, timestamped beats, camera, audio). All three share one grade (low-key, deep blacks, cyan #23D2E2 practical light, warm skin) so they read as a set side by side. No on-screen text or logos: video models garble lettering, and the real Xtudio logo is overlaid afterwards.

clips.title: Learn: the moment it clicks
clips.prompt: Realistic live-action cinematic footage, shot on 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, low-key lighting with deep blacks, a cool cyan screen glow as the key light and a warm practical lamp as fill, natural skin texture, 4K commercial look. Vertical frame. A focused young professional woman in her late twenties sits alone at a desk in a dark modern studio at night, her face lit by the cyan glow of an unseen screen; soft abstract reflections of moving light play across her glasses. [0s-2s] She leans in slightly, eyes tracking something on the screen, brow gently furrowed in concentration. [2s-4s] Her expression shifts as the idea lands: her eyes widen a little and a quiet, genuine smile forms. [4s-5s] She sits back, exhales, and nods to herself, the cyan light catching the edge of her face. Camera: slow, steady push-in from a medium close-up to a close-up, locked at eye level, focus holding on her eyes. Audio: soft room tone, faint keyboard taps, a warm low synth pad that swells gently as she smiles, one relaxed exhale, no dialogue, no music vocals.

clips.title: Think: the brain behind the behavior
clips.prompt: Realistic live-action cinematic macro footage, 100mm macro lens, extreme shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, low-key lighting, deep blacks, cyan rim light, subtle film grain, high-end commercial look. Vertical frame. An extreme close-up of a human eye in near darkness, every fibre of the iris in crisp detail, with tiny points of cyan light reflected on the glossy surface of the eye. [0s-2s] The eye is still, the pupil wide in the dark; the reflected points of light drift slowly across the cornea. [2s-4s] The points of light begin to connect into a delicate branching network, like neurons firing, reflected across the iris; the pupil contracts smoothly as the light brightens. [4s-5s] A single slow blink, then the eye opens again, sharper and brighter, the cyan network glowing softly in the reflection. Camera: locked-off macro with an extremely slow push-in and a subtle rack focus from the eyelashes to the iris. Audio: deep quiet ambience, a soft rising electrical shimmer as the light network forms, a faint heartbeat-like low pulse, a gentle whoosh on the blink, no dialogue.

clips.title: Lead: change that people choose
clips.prompt: Realistic live-action cinematic footage, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, low-key lighting with deep blacks, warm tungsten key light on her face and a strong cool cyan rim light from behind, cyan and teal color grade, natural skin texture, high-end corporate commercial look. Vertical frame. A confident Black woman in her mid-forties, a team leader in a dark charcoal blazer, stands in a dim, modern glass-walled office meeting room at night, city lights softly blurred through the glass behind her, facing her team, who are soft and out of focus in the foreground, dressed in business-casual long-sleeved shirts and sweaters. [0s-2s] She listens attentively, then smiles warmly and begins to speak, one open hand gesturing toward the team. [2s-4s] In the soft-focus foreground, team members nod and one leans forward, engaged; she steps half a pace closer, calm and encouraging. [4s-5s] She holds eye contact with the group, a small confident nod, the cyan rim light outlining her silhouette. Camera: slow lateral dolly from left to right past the out-of-focus shoulders of the team, ending on a medium close-up of her, eye level. Audio: soft room tone, the low murmur of an engaged team, a light warm piano note and low pad building gently, her voice heard only as an indistinct calm murmur, no clear words. No warehouse, no boxes, no shelving, no bare shoulders.
